observations: All photos show a large office copier/printer unit wrapped in plastic.
Photo 0 shows the brand/model marking: SHARP and model text that appears as AR-M207.
Photo 1 shows the same unit from a different angle; model text is partially visible.
Photo 2 shows SHARP AR-M207 marking again on the lower right front.

claims.evidence: No photo evidence of location/usage history (no serial/receipt/maintenance record shown).

claims.claim: The AR-M207 is packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions, delivering...
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos do not show the control panel, specs label, or any working demonstration.

risks.risk: Whether the machine is functional (power-on, prints/copies, no error codes). Photos are only of the exterior and wrapped condition.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine powered on with the screen showing no error, plus a test copy/print output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven/possibly not working until demonstrated.

risks.risk: Toner/toner cartridge and drum/consumables condition (could be low, missing, or worn). Plastic wrapping prevents checking.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the toner/drum access area (open cover) and a screenshot/photo of consumables status if the panel shows it.

risks.risk: Paper feed and internal rollers (pickup/ADF) may be faulty; exterior photos can’t confirm.
risks.proof: Video showing paper feeding from the tray and (if available) ADF scanning/copying.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: paper feed/ADF may require repair.

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (e.g., trays, bypass, cables, manuals, network module).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (power cable, network cable/module if any, trays, manuals) and a checklist from seller.

risks.risk: Model mismatch or incorrect unit (seller text mentions AR-M207 but photos must be confirmed).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the model/serial label (serial number visible) and the control panel model info (if shown).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the identified unit only if confirmed; otherwise treat as generic copier with unknown model.

proof_requests: Power-on video: screen on with no error + a test copy/print page.
Close-up of the serial/model label (serial number readable).
Photos of consumables status (toner level / drum life) or open the relevant cover to show toner/drum condition.
Video of paper feeding and (if it has ADF) a scan/copy from the ADF.
response.reason: The photos identify a Sharp AR-M207 copier, but there is no proof it works or what condition the consumables/feeds are in. For Lagos remote buying, the price must be based on worst-case until a power-on + test output is shown.
